findings: All final nineteen geometry views personally inspected: six per scene plus the puppet bottom. Sensory tray base top is y=.016, filler top .044 and rim top .086. Ring, block and scoop bottoms meet filler at .044. Shortened scoop handle clears the front wall; relocated block clears scoop. Side views correctly obscure shallow interior objects behind the walls.

Sensory revision changes ring size and toy colors/marking in the authoritative scene. Objects remain separated in top view and within the tray. The circle is a printed top motif, not a hole. Approximate tray dimensions .48 by .33 metres are a construction study, not supplied equipment specifications.

Foil sheet and crumpled form both reach y=0. The thin double-sided sheet has a raised folded corner, and the triangulated closed crumpled form is separate. Metallic shading is a simple material cue, not optical simulation. No cultural artifact shape was traced.

Two puppet sleeves have outer radius .016, inner radius .013, body height .073 and centers x=±.027. Both open at the bottom with closed caps; bottom view shows the inside cap through the opening rather than an impossible through-hole. Ears and facial felt features attach to their shells. No actual human anatomy or hand pose is depicted.

Interview and personal-statement icons are flat editorial diagrams. The briefcase handle joins its body and question/repeat bubbles remain separate. Avatar is a flat generic emblem, not a modeled person. All SVGs are self-contained without href, text, external raster content or scripts.

Five final-hash native cards at 128/32/24/16 on light and dark, ten actual IconManager variants, five custom references and four Noto references personally inspected. Only sensory-bin differs from the initial visual packet. Small-size ambiguities are documented; no blind recognition test or independent reviewer is claimed.

Creator critical pass with prior brief knowledge. Original approximate geometry was reviewed for apparent support, separation and perspective; no exhaustive collision or physical-material simulation was performed. All five assets remain below the size-review triggers.
